metadata.title: Evaluate to true if the aix-def:fix_test is properly supported
metadata.description: This definition is intended to evaluate to true if the interpreter properly supports the aix-def:fix_test.

notes.note: It is important to note that the values used in this test definition are specific to a particular machine, and may not necessarily apply to your system. As a result, in order to have the definition return a result of 'true', you must either change these values to the ones found on your particular system, or you must configure your system to use these values.

criterion.comment: Test that the fix_object is supported by getting APARs matching a pattern.

fix_test.comment: Test that the fix_object is supported by getting the instruction set architecture for a machine.

fix_object.comment: Collect two specific APARs: IJ27564 and IV97760.

fix_state.comment: This state represents the IJ27564 APAR.
This state represents the IV97760 APAR.
